name: @red-cup-engineering/cloudflare-d1-service
description: The Cloudflare D1 database handle contract -- prepare/bind/first/all/run/batch/exec -- with a local node:sqlite double and a migration applier, so Assist and every other Workers application store composes one D1 shape on the platform and in tests.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/sqlite-d1.mjs && node --check src/apply-migrations.mjs && node --check test/sqlite-d1.test.mjs && node --check test/apply-migrations.test.mjs
